data.value: SELECT dbo.NetRate_Quote_Insur_Quote_Locat.LocationID, dbo.NetRate_Quote_Insur_Quote_Locat.UnitNumber AS LocationNumber, ISNULL(dbo.NetRate_Quote_Insur_Quote_Locat_Premi.UnitNumber, 1) AS BuildingNumber, dbo.NetRate_Quote_Insur_Quote_Locat.Address, dbo.NetRate_Quote_Insur_Quote_Locat.City, dbo.NetRate_Quote_Insur_Quote_Locat.State, dbo.NetRate_Quote_Insur_Quote_Locat.ZipCode, NetRate_Quote_Insur_Quote_Locat_Premi.StreetSecondaryLocation, ISNULL(dbo.NetRate_Quote_Insur_Quote_Locat_Premi.BuildingIdentifier, 1) AS BuildingIdentifier FROM dbo.tblQuotes WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN dbo.NetRate_Quote_Insur_Quote_Locat WITH (NOLOCK) ON dbo.tblQuotes.NetRate_QuoteID = dbo.NetRate_Quote_Insur_Quote_Locat.QuoteID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.NetRate_Quote_Insur_Quote_Locat_Premi WITH (NOLOCK) ON dbo.NetRate_Quote_Insur_Quote_Locat_Premi.LocationID = dbo.NetRate_Quote_Insur_Quote_Locat.LocationID WHERE (dbo.tblQuotes.QuoteGUID = @QuoteGuid) ORDER BY LocationNumber
